verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document live or round-the-clock customer support for urgent account issues. The Cases API (wise-docs-17) lets users open and respond to support queries through an API, but that is an asynchronous ticketing channel rather than live, anytime support. One user's urgent complaint drew only a promise to investigate and respond within 30 days, which falls short of live help but does not contradict any vendor claim, so the verdict is none rather than disputed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can reach live customer support at any time for urgent account issues
